title: Valid Palindrome
description:
A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward. Alphanumeric characters include letters and numbers.
Given a string s, return true if it is a palindrome, or false otherwise.

examples.example_text:
Input: s = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"
Output: true
Explanation: "amanaplanacanalpanama" is a palindrome.

Input: s = "race a car"
Output: false
Explanation: "raceacar" is not a palindrome.

Input: s = " "
Output: true
Explanation: s is an empty string "" after removing non-alphanumeric characters.
Since an empty string reads the same forward and backward, it is a palindrome.

constraints: s consists only of printable ASCII characters.

test_snippets.python3:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(s = "race a car") == false
    assert candidate(s = " ") == true
    assert candidate(s = "Able was I ere I saw Elba") == True
    assert candidate(s = "__Level__) == True
    assert candidate(s = "No lemon) == True
    assert candidate(s = "0P") == False
    assert candidate(s = "_a!a_") == True
    assert candidate(s = "Never odd or even") == True
    assert candidate(s = "12345678987654321") == True
    assert candidate(s = "Was it a car or a cat I saw?") == True
    assert candidate(s = "No 'x' in Nixon") == True
    assert candidate(s = "Able was I) == True
    assert candidate(s = "12321") == True
    assert candidate(s = "Not a palindrome") == False
    assert candidate(s = "Able was I) == True
    assert candidate(s = "123abcba321") == True
    assert candidate(s = "Step on no pets") == True
    assert candidate(s = "A man) == True
    assert candidate(s = "Madam) == True
    assert candidate(s = "123abccba321") == True
    assert candidate(s = "__^_^__") == True
test_snippets.golang:
func check(candidate func([]int, int) []int) {
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("race a car"), false)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(" "), true)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Able was I ere I saw Elba"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("__Level__), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("No lemon), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("0P"), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("_a!a_"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Never odd or even"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("12345678987654321"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Was it a car or a cat I saw?"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("No 'x' in Nixon"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Able was I), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("12321"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Not a palindrome"), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Able was I), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("123abcba321"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Step on no pets"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("A man), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("Madam), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("123abccba321"), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate("__^_^__"), True)
}
